Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rohan - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Zoya - 11 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Meenakshi - 42 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Karan - 42 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Rohan stands in the living room. Meenakshi, Karan and Zoya stand near him.]

Zoya: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rohan reads a storybook.]

Meenakshi: "I knew it!"

[Rohan studies for his exam.]

Rohan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rohan talks to his father on the phone.]

Rohan: "That was fun!"

[Rohan's phone rings and he answers it.]

Rohan (laughing): "Yes, of course."

[Rohan types on his laptop.]

Rohan: "Really?"

[Rohan watches cartoons on TV.]

Rohan: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Zoya, Meenakshi and Karan stand near him.]

Karan: "Let's begin."

[Rohan folds his hands and prays.]

Rohan (gently): "Zoya, are you okay?"

[Rohan lights a diya.]

Karan: "Hmm, I see."

[Zoya draws a rangoli at the door.]

Karan (softly): "Careful!"

[Rohan paints a picture.]

Zoya: "I'm ready!"

[Rohan draws a picture of the house.]

Karan: "Careful!"

Scene 3: The bedroom - Day

Karan: "Meenakshi, look over here."

[Rohan stretches his arms above his head.]

Meenakshi: "Rohan, listen!"

[Rohan goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Karan (happily): "Let's see."

[Rohan sits on the edge of the bed.]

Karan: "That was such a fun day!"
